governing_record.scope: New synthetic register/addendum implements owner-approved equal economic and ordinary unit-vote rights; authorized voluntary paid-in contributions issue no units. Preserves current nine-member board, CEO/Chair separation and investor/independent roles. No operational veto, new preference, conversion, anti-dilution, option pool or privileged information access.
governing_record.side_letter_disposition: No unlisted side letter is adopted or asserted absent. Substantive designation thresholds remain outside this register.

founder_basis_boundary.impact: No historical contributed cash/property/services or enforceable contribution promise; zero monetary opening and initial tax basis. Approved units unchanged; no cash, compensation deduction, intellectual-property asset, goodwill or equity plug.

cash_boundary: 183000000historical subscription receipts are newly authored precision of accepted rounds; not additional2026cash. Internal synthetic settlement references are not independent bank confirmation. No founder secondary.

founder_formation.event_order: At legal formation, before first operating engagement, asset purchase or corporate service performance; no invented exact intraday clock.
founder_formation.formation_fee_boundary: Formation/registered-agent administrative services were vendor invoiced to the newly formed company after admission and settled within existing 2016 administrative cost population; no founder-paid cost or waived founder reimbursement. No added annual cost.
founder_formation.personal_experience_boundary: Founders retained their personal expertise and Blackridge-derived understanding; no exclusive technology, copyright assignment, transferable customer list or predecessor going business was conveyed for units. Company work product arose only from later company services.

valuation.method: New synthetic formation-stage rights and assets census, corroborated by absence of enforceable revenue/funding rights; not inferred only from cash balance.
reasons: No assigned business, tangible property, proprietary product, contract backlog or legally committed future services at admission.
Professional capability and an untested services thesis were personal; no enterprise asset or binding pipeline was transferred.

No third-party offer, capital commitment or reasonably supportable positive cashflow attributable to enterprise rights at admission. Later services and 2021/2022 financing cannot be backdated into this measurement.
valuation.reassessment_trigger: Any earlier company-owned IP, transferred business, binding customer/funding commitment, nonzero interest value or service vesting condition requires new valuation and section83/basis workpaper; zero result must not silently persist.

tax_analysis.section83_scope: Tested even if founding participation is considered connected with future services. Units are substantially vested at admission; no substantial risk of forfeiture is authored.
tax_analysis.basis_formula: amount paid plus amount includible under section83; no basis for personal expertise not transferred
